items.question: What qualifying attribute of length and the like belongs to these entities?
premises: A preceding statement establishes a prohibition regarding the conch.
The entities in question are identified as these.
The quality of being long and so forth is attributed to them.
items.inference: Despite the stated prohibition, these entities possess the attribute of length and similar qualities.
uncertainties: The specific entities referred to by etāsām are not explicitly named in this verse.
items.plain_english: But these have the quality of being long and so forth.
